subject: ZenWell SOC 2 discovery - post-call recap and next steps
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir@zenwell.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: ZenWell SOC 2 discovery - post-call recap and next steps

Hi Samir -

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum on the security/contract side. Overall you called out two main priorities:

1) Evidence for SOC 2 controls (audit report, control narratives, pen test artifacts)
2) Data handling specifics (retention windows, audit/log access, DPA language & data flows)

Summary of what we covered:
- Redwood has a current SOC 2 Type II report covering CC1-CC5 controls (we reviewed scope and assessor). I can share the redacted report and a short one-page control-summary.
- Audit logs: we retain API & admin audit logs for 13 months by default; logs are available via Console export or S3 push. We also support ad-hoc log pulls for audits.
- Data retention: customer data retention defaults can be configured per-tenant; typical retention for model input/output is 30 days unless longer retention is requested and contracted.
- DPA & data flows: we walked through our standard DPA terms (data subprocessors, cross-border clauses). Priya (legal) flagged a few items to discuss in negotiation.
- Pen test evidence: we can provide a high-level summary and proof-of-engagement artifacts; full reports are typically shared under NDA.

Action items / next steps (owners & timing):
- Neha: share redacted SOC 2 summary + control matrix and the stub pen-test evidence (today) - attachments included.
- Rishi: schedule technical deep-dive with your infra/security team to demo audit log exports and retention routing (ideally this week).
- Marissa: introduce sales/legal checklist and share DPA draft for initial review.
- Samir/Priya: confirm any additional compliance evidence you'd like to see and target timeline for procurement/legal review.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf (redacted), RW-pen-test-evidence-stub.pdf, DPA_draft_v1.docx

Please reply with times that work for the technical deep-dive and any specific items Priya wants called out in the DPA redlines. Happy to run through anything on Wednesday/Thursday.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0124

---
Redwood Inference - Make inference predictable and economical
From: Samir Gupta <samir@zenwell.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@zenwell.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ZenWell SOC 2 discovery - post-call recap and next steps

Thanks Neha - this is great and captures the conversation. A couple quick clarifications from our side:

- Retention: Our security policy requires a 90-day access window for PII logs and a separate archival policy for 7 years for audit records. Can Redwood support 90-day active retention and longer cold-archive exports?
- Logs: We'd like to see a sample of the audit log schema (timestamp, actor, action, request_id, resource) and an example export.
- Pen test: We can do NDA if needed; priya.shah@zenwell.com will coordinate legal.

For the tech deep-dive, Wed 6/9 10:00-11:00 PT works for our infra/security leads. If that works for Rishi, we'll lock it.

Thanks,
Samir
Director, IT Security | ZenWell Health
samir@zenwell.com | +1 (617) 555-4420
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ZenWell SOC 2 discovery - post-call recap and next steps

Thanks for the recap Neha - nicely summarized. Couple notes from the sales/legal side:

- I'll drop the DPA_draft_v1.docx into the shared Drive link and call out the sections I expect ZenWell to flag (data subprocessors, deletion timelines, and audit rights).
- For retention: 90-day active retention for PII is reasonable; we can support 90 days for active retention and provide an archival/export path for 7-year storage. Need to confirm with infra on indexing/cost.
- I'll also surface a provisional pricing note for extended retention/export to avoid surprises.

Action items for internal owners:
- Neha: send SOC 2 summary + log schema example (Neha: can you attach the log-schema-sample.json or paste a sample in a follow-up?)
- Rishi: confirm availability for Wed 6/9 10:00 PT and plan agenda:
  - quick overview of audit log fields and retention controls (15m)
  - demo: Console log export -> S3 push (20m)
  - Q&A on DPA/legal asks (25m)

I'll cc Legal here once we have times locked.

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
